note: Illinois DNR recreation area near Oakwood on reclaimed strip-mine land, with 22 deep-water ponds along the Middle Fork of the Vermilion River. The electric loops are wooded; Fox loop's sites 88 and 90 look across an open slope down to the river. Since 2026 the river has been closed to public access while IDNR assesses seepage from a lake embankment (park alert, read 2026-11-12). --Claude
summary: DNR camping/park pages, ExploreMoreIL (all six loops, 183 units) and the 2027 fee PDF read. 184 sites: 101 Class A electric (30 A, 50 A at 23; no water/sewer at sites; 7 pull-throughs; 40 ft, two at 50) in Fox/Illini/Miami; non-electric Redear (40 ft) and Erie/Sauk (20 ft). 2027 $11 non-electric / $28 electric (stored 11/11 + surcharge restated; reservation fee cleared). Showers/water/dump winterized Dec 15 - Mar 31. Booking operator -> usedirect #!park/35, max stay 14 confirmed. Manual year_round season left (consistent). Waterfront lakeview -> riverview recommended (Fox 88/90). River closed (seepage alert). Phone 217-442-4915 (none stored).
flags: WATERFRONT: recommend lakeview -> riverview. The stored evidence rests on Erie Loop's open meadow by the water, but Erie's sites take 20 ft (all but 134, which is ~65 m back), so they don't count for a 23-ft rig. The best RV sites are Fox (Class A, 50 A, 40 ft) 88 at 40.13365,-87.73780 and 90 at 40.13354,-87.73755: an open meadow runs ~40-48 m to the Middle Fork Vermilion (river ~50 m wide), but 3DEP puts the pads on a bench at 178 m with a ~27% grassy slope down to the water at ~167-169 m (40.13350 -> 40.13320). That is a climb-down slope, so riverview, not riverfront. No Class A pad looks over a lake (Illini/Miami are wooded inland).

SEASON: manual year_round (2026-10-20) left as it is; the pages agree (FCFS outside May-Oct, walk-ins all year). New detail for a human: the park alert says 'Fox campground, Erie campground, Redear campground ... will be closed at first snowfall until spring', so in winter only Illini/Miami (and Sauk) stay open; facilities closed Dec 15 - Mar 31. Consider adding that to season.note (not written: the group is manual).

ALERTS (dated caveats, 2026-11-12): lake-embankment seepage, river closed to public access; Middle Fork streambank project from Sep 14, 2026 (~90 days, 750 ft of shoreline). Neither closes the campground.

FEES: stored 11/11 + electric surcharge 17 -> low 11 / high 28 with the surcharge and per-entry reservation fee cleared (state:IL row), checked 2026 -> 2027. The $11 base is a real RV option: Redear's 30 non-electric sites are drive-in and listed at 40 ft (Erie/Sauk at 20 ft would not count).
